text:
claire: quick heads-up — during a staging drain we saw tenant tail latency spike when controller immediately sent traffic to CPU fallback.
ben: binary spillover again?
claire: yup. operator marked reservation gone -> controller flipped routes -> instant spike.
rohit: we need a safe evaluation path: sample a small percent to the candidate fallback, measure p50/p95/p99 and error delta, then decide.
anya: agree. propose minimal policy: sample_rate=0.05, window_s=20, p99_mult=2.0, p50_mult=1.5, err_delta=0.005, ramp=[25,60,100].
ben: also support fallback_order so operator prefers smaller GPU slices before CPU when packing allows.
rohit: operator must emit metrics: fallback.eval.start, fallback.eval.p99_ratio, fallback.ramp.step, fallback.oscillation_count (tagged by tenant, eval_id, variant).
claire: API sketch: POST /operator/v1/reservations/{id}/fallbacks {policy, mode:start|abort|promote} -> 202 {eval_id}; GET /operator/v1/evals/{eval_id} -> status+metrics.
anya: RBAC: promote/abort only platform-admin or tenant-admin. read allowed to broader roles.
ben: add oscillation protection: if toggles >3 within 60s, disable auto-promote and alert ops; metric: fallback_oscillation_count.
rohit: placement nuance: operator should check packability per ramp step. if gpu-small can't place due to fragmentation, skip to next variant and emit placement_failure. add allow_partial_packing flag default=false.
ops-bot: incident created INC-4527 for staging p99 regression :rotating_light:
claire: testing plan: unit for sampler, integration with fake packing, staged chaos run to trigger drains, and UX in console for manual abort/promote.
rohit: I'll take the operator proto + eval engine, ben can wire controller ramping, anya will do console + alerts, claire will own tests. I'll draft a short RFC follow-up with the policy snippet and link INC-4527.
ben: thanks — small change but should prevent surprise p99 spikes. :thumbsup:
